{{Top|ca|leg}}
A '''zee-gee table''' was a type of game popular with [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. A zee-gee table was located within the recreation room of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]], the ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]''. Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Celestial''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunctioned, and the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] fell into [[otherspace]], a realm between [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref>

{{RPG|[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]}}
A group of Rebels later unintentionally entered otherspace after they attempted to escape from an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and its complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. They had intended to rendezvous with the ''Celestial'' and, coming across the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] ship in otherspace, boarded it to determine its fate. In their search for clues, members of the group came across the zee-gee table floating due to the ''Celestial''{{'s}} loss of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="Otherspace" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
A zee-gee table appeared in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]] campaign book [[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', which was written by [[Bill Slavicsek]]. The player characters may optionally explore the recreation room of the ''Celestial'', and as such they may not necessarily discover the zee-gee table.<ref name="Otherspace" />
